Whether the route involves glacier travel / needs a rope and crevasse-rescue gear

before.detailed_rack: No fixed rock rack is documented for this route. The Mountaineers program the Mutchler add-on as a Basic Glacier Climb, so parties carry standard glacier-travel gear (rope, harness, crevasse-rescue hardware, crampons, ice axe) rather than a traditional protection rack.
before.pro_needs: Protection needs are glacier-travel oriented (crevasse-rescue kit, and pickets if the Mutchler Glacier crossing warrants them) rather than rock protection; no fixed anchors or bolted protection are documented on the scrambling sections.
